company_info.company_description: "Needless to say that many of these original installation companies have all disappeared, and in the Sunshine Coast alone, there would be many thousands of orphaned solar systems looking for support.From our early days we decided that we wanted to provide an excellent solar experience for our customers and generate a long-lasting high performing solar system."

reviews.review_description: From the excellent initial site visit to the well-informed quote to the efficient installation process I found SolarWide a pleasure to deal with. Following a minor issue at installation SolarWide were quick rectify to my satisfaction. Assistance from SolarWide to deal with connection to the grid and all I need to know going forward was excellent. I happily recommend SolarWide

The quote was detailed, clear and accurate.The customer service was excellent and pre-install preparation was thorough.The installation itself was punctual, without incident and very neat.They organise hot water timers, grid connection and clearly explained the system with ongoing tech support as needed.

Sales and quoting was excellent and dealing with an actual electrical qualified person during the review was the right process!Installation team were excellent and lead well but the team leader providing a well installed system. On time and very clean.

Excellent company to deal with.  The quoting process was informative, not pushy and provided several options without being overly technical.  The installation was completed by a friendly team who were tidy, diligent and clearly knew their stuff.  Performance of the system has been superb.

Went with Solarwide due to previous reviews and recommended by friend. Sales person provided good information pack and answered all my questions. Greensure offered a cheaper quote, however panels were Jinko instead of Trina and racking was not on solar quotes recommended list. Grid connection arranged after install. Overall positive experience.

Quoting process was good and not pushyInstallation was quick and left the site tidy. Installers were friendly, keeping us in the loop with their progress throughout the day. They organised all the grid connection making the process a breeze.They explained everything after they finished.
All of the above were done with consideration of the purchaser. No battery just solar panels and inverter.

Very friendly and efficient in all aspects of service, from quoting to installation and after-installation contact.Adrian was informative and explained the system requirements efficiently.The installers arrived punctually and cleaned up afterwards.
Easy all round. Flexible and friendly. No troubles out even a single issue nearly two years on

Informative discussion about the solar system, without pushing into a certain directionInstallation was great, with quick install and always ready for explanations.Everything was nicely installed and also cleaned up afterwards.Also on any questions Solarwide was always ready to help
Really Impressed from the honest and upfront conversations with the Sales Team, support from the Admin team and the professional and informative installation team.

The Solar Wide installers did a great job, were very neat, and took care with the placement of ladders and equipment.The handover covered everything i needed to know.The after-sales service has also been excellent.
The Sales/quoting precess was through and accurate.The installation went to plan, site was left clean tidyThe  installer informed me how to get grid connected and operation of the system

We are so happy with our Solar system from SolarWide. The initial inspection was prompt and on time. The installation guys were so respectful, giving great service and advice. Very quick install. Even when we had hail damage two months later and had to get the whole system replaced these guys were just as good the second time around.

The pre-install inerview removed any doubts that I had chosen the right firm.  Differenet systems were discussed until I felt that I had chosen he system to suit our house. The installation was done in conjunction with roof restoration that was underway.  SolarWide tradesman were  professional in performance, punctual and kept me in the loop as work progressed. Both Solarwide and the restorer worked seamlessly on various days to suit onlgoing work. Grid connection was assisted by Solarwide.  After connection, I was given a thorough briefing of the systema nd charger. I would thoroughly recommend the services of SolarWide.  To date the system is working faultlessly.

We have had our system here since August 2022.  It has worked really well and whenever we have had an issue we have had a very quick and genuinely engaged response from Solar Wide.  We have a complicated roof and the approach to the layout and function of the system was very carefully considered.  The installation was done in and extremely professional manner and the team was always polite and friendly.  I would highly recommend Solar Wide to anyone considering a solar system.  They are very straightforward and a pleasure to deal with.

The sales person came to the house and made an honest assessment of the best system for me. The installation was on time and the work was tidy and efficient and they cleaned up all mess. Do to my roof configuration they needed to pull up some tin sheets to run a cable. They solved the problem quickly and put everything back properly. I have had a lot of rain since the install and no leaks.Customer service following the installation was excellent, I was able to call any of the staff (office, installer, sales person) and all picked up the phone or returned the call within 24h to answer any questions I had.I feel like I am in good hands and I am confident if I had any issues they would be quick to respond. Both apps I have to monitor the input and output were up and working on the day.

From start to finish and beyond, Solar Wide have been fantastic. Super friendly and helpful,  both in person and on the phone. Installation was seamless and easy for me to understand the equipment. After sales service is awesome, with Solar Wide contacting me when there was a hail storm in my area to make sure everything was fine with my system (it was!)Highly recommend Solar Wide!
Initial meeting, ongoing support, installation process  and after sales support have been outstanding. Adrian is still in touch with us 12mths post instal.

Couldn't have asked for better service. With multiple quotes going with Solarwide was an easy choice to make and we weren't disappointed. The quoting, installation and follow up to make sure everything was okay was faultless

The sales and quoting was the best of the three quotes we obtained.The installers were extremely punctual, and the work was well done and we were kept UpToDate on how things were progressing. At the end of the instillation two roof tiles had been cracked- not broken just a small crack, something we were told may happen just due to people on the roof, we were made aware of this at the time and the only spare tile I had was used to replace one. The other was siliconed and I was given a phone number of a local business that caried replacement tiles.  What surprised me was the small number of tiles that were actually damaged with the amount of work done installing the solar pannels.They supplied the required information so we could hook up to the grid. We were given a good run down on the converter and how to link to our phones.Over all I would highly recommend SolarWide.

Right from the start these guys were on the ball, always returned every phone call (Thanks Cas) answered all our questions and sorted the quote promptly. Turned up on time for installation and put up with our big annoying dog Bruce all day!The guys were great and explained the whole system to us and left no mess behind.My husband even shouted them a beer he was so impressed !

Solarwide installed our Solar System and we were very happy with the lead up, installation and back up. Communication was good at all times and the whole process was professional and prompt. We were shown what to do with the system and we had one small problem with a relay switch in our power board which was quickly dealt with by the Solarwide team. We highly recommend Solarwide on the Sunshine Coast.
Solarwide are very professional and easy to work with every step of the way

Very happy with installation of solar system. Was able to get Tier 1 panels and excellent inverter which has not missed a beat in the last 18 months. Very neat installation in a difficult two storey villa. All conduits out of view.
I am fully satisfied. The seller is expirienced and the installation team are part of the company, not subcontractor.

Solar wide advised me very well and installed a high quality 3Kw solar system which I am very happy with.Date of Installation: 02/02/2023Size of System: 3.28Inverter Brand: Sungrow - SG3.0RS,Solar Panel Brand: REC - Alpha Pure R - 410W - REC410AA PureR

So glad we used Solarwide to provide and install our home solar system. They gave excellent advice up front that helped us select a system that comprised quality components. On installation day they were punctual, polite and worked efficiently, including giving an easily understood explanation of system operation. The installed system is neat and works brilliantly. We have had no issues since. We strongly recommend Solarwide.

Warwick came and actually went up the roof to inspect and explained what he can do, all the other quotes that I got was just based on pictures of our roof online. I think Because he was a previous installer that’s why he actually knows what he was talking about.On the day of the install, 4 guys came on time. Explained to me their process before they started and was very polite. Also appreciated that they removed their shoes when they inspected the house to check access, but they did explain that they have to wear shoes for safety once they start working.Install finished at 3pm, explained to me the process of post install and what the next steps are. No headaches with grid connection.
From quote to install, solar wide were great to deal with! Communication was regular and workmanship of tradies top notch. Our solar system hasn't skipped a  beat and has saved us heaps.

I was offered SolarWide as a provider after going through SolarQuotes to give me an idea of who in my area was able to get me a replacement for my 1.5kw system after the inverter failed. Of the 3 quotes I received, SolarWide were able to give me a replacement closest to what I had. They were extremely professional with great communication and advice.Unfortunately 1.5kw systems are difficult to obtain so the high cost was not a reflection on SolarWide. If I was prepared to lose my feed-in tariff I could have had a much bigger system for the same price.

They were very helpful and answered all my questions satisfactorily.Installation didn't take longer than expected. An accidental small hole was made in one of the rooms during installation, but they were very apologetic and quick to have it fixed at no charge.I was shown how to use the inverter and everything was set up and working on the day before they left.I would definitely recommend SolarWide.

SolarWide sales were very helpful with information and advice to assist my decision on the system size, choice of panels and inverter and most effective positioning of panels on roof. I was considering a larger system but was advised the 6.63 kw system would adequately meet my solar energy needs. The installation team were efficient, considerate, and tidy. They supported me with grid connection and on using the inverter and app. Since installation over two years ago, I have been given support on a couple of occasions re questions on my home power efficiency, how to improve it, including adjustment of timers, or whether  I can get a better plan from my energy company.  They have also checked my system a couple of times either remotely or in person, after I'd requested assistance. Happy to recommend SolarWide.
Sales & installation process was very smooth.I highly recommend Solarwide
Very professional from the quoting stage through to final customer support. We could not fault any aspect of dealing with Solarwide. Everyone that has seen the installation remarkes on the quality.

Thank you for asking for review.  All seems to be  working well. We were a little surprised that the hot water was separate feature.The after service seemed to be lacking.  It would have been good to get a phone call to ask us do we have any questions etc.thank youK and R Webster

Superb team from start to finish. Very knowledgable and contactable, and look at all the possible issues. They use top quality products and the installers were great. We went with REC alpha panels, which they have great experience with. Can't fault them! There is a reason they're already highly recommended. Would definitely use them again in the future if we decided to grow our solar plant.
Solarwide installed a new solar system for us. They removed the old system and installed a new one with a minimum of fuss. They arrived when they said they would and completed the job efficiently.
Solarwide installed a new solar system for us. They removed the old system and installed a new one with a minimum of fuss. They arrived when they said they would and completed the job efficiently.

SolarWide was very professional without  the high pitched sales tactics.Our installation was done on time with minimal disruption. All SolarWide staff have been helpful and excellent with communication.
Seamless process from start to completion.  Site visit was no issue.  The installers came and included me in all discussions.  A great experience.
Solarwide were terrific to deal with and produced a no fuss install. They have a great range of quality products and the REC panels and Fronius Inverter have functioned perfectly.

After my initial phone call, SolarWide sent out a consultant within just a few days.  He was very thorough, explaining everything to us clearly. He highlighted the differences between the types of solar systems and panels and we were very satisfied with our choice.  He measured up, sent a quote very quickly and within three weeks we hade our new 6.6kw solar system.  It has made a very big difference to our energy bill as we also run a pool filter. The job was done by very friendly and knowledgeable men who also explained how to use the system to our best advantage. We are extremely happy with everything!

Quote was easy to organise, Adrian was punctual and authentic - I never felt like I was being 'pushed' a thing but it was more of a conversation on what we wanted to achieve etc. Installation was stress-free, staff were friendly and workmanship was great. I'd recommend SolarWide for anything residential solar without a second thought and will be reaching back out to them when the time comes for us to compliment our solution with battery.

Our experience with Solar wide is excellent.From initial enquiry to any questions we have ongoing they have been easy to deal with. They always answer/ed our questions and the staff are very friendly.Recommend them highly! A++++

Knowledgable sales process - gave several options and happy to discuss.Order to install was quick and smooth - zero issues in the last 2 years since installation.Any minor questions they are happy to respond with clear information and documentation.

On site inspection was in depth, explanation of process and system options very thorough. Install team on time,good workmanship and professional approach to the job, overview of system explanation and tips was excellent.3 pannel arrays required for multi level roof.Grid connection with meter changeover was organised by Solarwide office.

The Solar supplier has there own installers- not subcontracted out which is great. They did pull everything off the wall in the garage to run the cables for the inverter but did also put everything back how it was. Very neat and took the time to consult the best position for the inverter. Cleaned up all the mess and left the way it was found. Took the time to run through correct shutdown and boot up procedures should this be required.

Great service, products and installation. The solar installer world is fraught with dodgies but Solarwide are long term suppliers and their products have proven track record. Very happy and would recommend this company, no worries.

SolarWide recently installed a 6.6kw Solar Panel & Inverter System to our home and I couldn’t be happier.Great communications, speaking English straightaway to a real human. Any questions answered. Kept in touch with installation date. Organised new meter to sell back to the grid.Professional workmanship.Prices competitive.Walked into the shop afterwards and was given help with the ISolarCloud App.Thanks SolarWide.Happy Camper
Tidy and punctual (uncommon these days). Gave pertinent info from following email within a few hours.
All of the above great after sales enquires . Cordial office staff.

The sales person was very polite, professional and actually came to our home to check out the roof (went up on) and placement of inverter, if we went a head with them, which we did. Communication between admin people was great, they sent through all relevant documents and organised an install date that suited. The installers were prompt, polite and very helpful. Got the install done in very good time.

Very prompt reply to initial request for quote. Insisted on doing a site visit prior to quote which was extremely beneficial as panels required to place on two seperate areas of roof due to house position. Super quick installation time frame. The installers were prompt, pleasent, professional and fast. Installed hot water timer and we were connected to the grid within a week.
No high pressure sales, reliable proven brands.All staff very helpful and reliable.

Solarwide were way out in front from the quote stage and as we progressed to the installation we were just as impressed. Timing and being kept up to date with what was happening was very good. The office staff and installers were friendly and informative. All in all a very good experience with Solarwide.

I choose Solar wide due to fact that they were the only ones that actually came to my house and got on top of the shed and measure my roof space. After getting 8 quotes I found that everyone had there own ideas, many were to make there installation easy for themselves rather than look after the customer.Solarwide guarantee there panels (rec) and workmanship. I wanted the inverter in the shed that means running a heavier guage wire 16 mm to the switch board. Most installers wanted a smaller guage wire which mean a voltage drop and cheaper.It pays to do your diligence before engaging a supplier.I wouldn't hesitate in recommending solarwide to any my friends and family.The salesperson and the installation where 100%

The company arranged an in-house quote straight away.  Adrian was informative and answered all my questions. The installation seemed easy, the people on site were punctual and friendly to both my self and my 3 year old inquisitive neighbour. Everything was left neat and tidy. The grid connection was explained thoroughly.

The installation was pushed back a few days due to wet weather. Without prompting  they installed the system quicker than I had expected with the weather delay.There was an issue with the catch power relay. Again without prompting the Catch Power technician came out promptly and sorted the issue (firmware incompatibility issue).

The salesperson was helpful, explained everything, and was always available if I rang up with any queries.Installation was done within a day and tradesmen polite  and explained the different things I needed to know and left no rubbish.They organized the grid connection and have always been polite and helpful when I have any questions.

I received 2 quotes, as requested and their was little difference in price or equipment.. As this was a system extension I felt the SolarWide quote gave me the best option, although their was minimal difference. The installation did have a hiccup but I tend to judge not the problem but how the problem is addressed and I was pretty impressed by the rectification. System was installed quickly and in line with the quoted time-frame. I am pretty happy with the result.

Solarwide was the only quoter to access the roof and measure up prior to offering their quote. The salesperson was experienced on installations and was technically competent to explain the system and answer all of our questions. The installation team were punctual, very professional and keen to meet our expectations. In summary, dealing with Solarwide was fuss free and a pleasure. The system is very neat and meets all our expectations.

SolarWide installed a 6.6Kw system at my home today(9/05/23).Excellent customer service followed by excellent installation.The team arrived at my home at 7.30am and were finished by 12.00pm.The team were very punctual polite and tidy.I have no hesitation in recommending SolarWide to any one thinking of installing a solar system.Everything from the grid connection to my solar app on my phone was done perfectly.Thank You again.John Stevula Peregian Springs QLD.
The team arrived on time, installed the gear very professionally, were considerate of us and explained the system very professionally and clearly.
Great faultless service from initial quote to instal and operation. Very aware of certification process when I requested extended brackets for panel supports
They were one of your 3 quotes and had best customer service and information on the systemsWe would recommend them.

I was very pleased with the whole process that followed the receipt of SolarQuotes' recommendations re solar suppliers. Two suppliers contacted me very quickly and sent representatives to our home to do a more detailed inspection of our requirements and to talk us through hardware selection and the installation process. Both representatives were punctual, polite and knowledgeable and provided written quotes by email very soon after their visits. The third supplier did contact me a day or so later but by that stage I had decided on REC 370 solar panels and a Fronius Primo inverter which the other two suppliers had both quoted, so I turned the third supplier off. I selected SolarWide as their quote was the cheaper of the two and they also had strong on-line reviews.The whole process dealing with SolarWide was slick and painless. Payment of a deposit got the ball rolling and they installed our 6.6 kW system about six weeks later (which was the earliest available installation day in their schedule). The installation team arrived on time and got straight to work. About four hours later our system was up and running. Luckily I already had a suitable smart meter so that aspect of the installation was simplified. I received all required manuals in PDF form by email soon after the installation was complete and I had paid the balance owing. SolarWide then arranged for our meter to be reconfigured and we are now enjoying a system that generates about 40 kWh on a sunny QLD day, with the exported electricity (starting from the day of installation) already appearing in our account.I would strongly recommend SolarWide to anyone considering solar for their home - they were professional and efficient, have a good selection of quality hardware to choose from and are appropriately accredited for all tasks.

Nothing to complain.about here quote was prompt on time and informative installation carried out in a professional manner all the questions answered.customer service was excellent stayed in touch let me know when crew would be on site how long approximately job would take any problems just contact them very easy to deal with

The SolarQuotes team were a pleasure to deal with. The salesperson/assessor (Warwick) was very knowledgeable and relaxed (no sales pressure). The installation team were friendly and efficient, the system was on the roof, and up and running by midday.
Well pleased with the service I received from Solar Wide, always they answered my phone calls. Did a professional job. Would recommend them???? to anyone.

All three companies recommended by SolarQuotes were came back quickly with competitive quotes and came across as very professional, but SolarWide went that extra yard in respect to clarification of my initial queries, flexibility of products offered, and price. In addition, the installation went ahead smoothly and the ongoing customer service has been excellent. I can recommend SolarWide with confidence. Review date: Dec 2021.

The sales person was very informative and friendly. I have to say that one of the main reasons I went with Solar Wide was because of the sales person.The installers were polite, friendly and informative. They did their job well, it was very tidy and explained some things before leaving.Overall a great experience!
Sales process was straight forward and easy to deal with. Pretty much a set and forget process once the system was selected and agreed install date.
Solar quote process went well, felt confident, was all done within 2 months from start to finish. I feel confident.
Sales/quoting was quick and efficient.Installation was very punctual, excellent and friendly installers.Customer service was excellent and yes they helped organise the grid connection.
Sales/quoting was friendly and professional. The install team was punctual. Neat and tidy install. Solarwide took care of everything.

The sales / quoting process went well. The comparison sheet provided by Solar Quotes was very usefulThe system installation was completed by 3pm. They were polite, tidy, punctual and consultative during the installationSolar Wide organised Origin for the meter changeover which was completed yesterday. We have not yet confirmed the feed back into the grid is operational.

Terrific company. Totally professional at every stage from the initial sales visit by Jeb, the communication from Cas and Andrew in the office to the installation and handover by Cal, Nick and the team. I highly recommend this company. Totally ethical and honest, a trait sadly lacking in many in this industry.Jen was precise, detailed and very knowledgeable in the initial sales visit. No ra, ra sales techniques, just solid professional advice. We went for the recommended top spec, LG panels and Fronius inverter solution and couldn’t be happier. Well done guys. We are becoming obsessed with watching how how our solar production is going in the App and the wonderful savings and credits generated.

The quote was done very quickly and professionally. Warwick answered all one thousand of my questions.I considered the system price with the 10kWh battery to be fair. The installation went smoothly with the team persisting all day to get it finished. I thank them a lot.Customer service was great, set up my app and gave me a full run down of the system after it was installed.Thanks!

The sales representative was punctual and courteous during the presales stage of the quotation section.After the contract and deposit were finalised the installation of the solar system was carried out without any problems. The installation team setup the paperwork, electrics and wifi connection.Customer service after installation hasn't been that great. There wasn't any helpful advice on how to manage the system.The Smart meter for the inverter was fitted and is supplying information through the application on mobile devices and PC. The interpretation of the information is a problem.Is the system being utilised to give the best results for the purchaser?   Not sure.
Every detail of the installation was completed professionally including follow-up telephone calls and commissioning of the pv system with our electricity supplier.
Quick response to quote request . Great and prompt installation. Friendly  installation team.
All aspects of the process were undertaken efficiently, promptly and professionally.
Prompt and professional service, a great experience for us. It all went smoothly and easy.
Great process and good communication from the start from initial contact through to final installation which only happened last week! Would have no hesitation in recommending this company.

Salesman did onsite visit before quoting. He was very prompt and had good knowledge of installation and product.I was very happy with the quote.Installation was perfect. Began right on prearranged time and I was very happy with the time it took and was kept in the loop with everything that they were doing. All were very polite. Very neat job a everything tidy when job was completed.The customer service has been wonderful from start to finish. They did everything needed with the electricity service provider and provided me with all of the information that I needed to deal with them as well.

We were impressed with Dan when he came out to give us a quote. After introducing himself ge went up on the roof and did some measurements. He sat and explained how panels would be fitted and why the number and positioning.The crew came out to fit when they said they would and were efficient and friendly.We would happily recommend  them.

We are super happy with our new solar system. From the day they quoted to install day and even afterwards, SolarWide have been great. Everyone I dealt with in the team were quick and happy to answer any questions I had and work with our requirements. The information we received throughout the process was always easy to understand and the install looks very professional and tidy. They even helped set up the iSolarCloud App on my phone.We're looking forward to many years of efficient solar energy!
Everything from quote through installation went quickly and smoothly. Knowledgeable staff and great customer service.

Sales process was as expected but Solarwide had accurate prices and specs right from the beginning of the sales process.  The Installers were professional and informative, they arrived on time and answered any questions I had.  Customer service with Solar Wide was timely and easy all emails to them were answered quickly, any problems were quickly fixed in an efficient manner.  I have no problem recommending Solar Wide for their Installation, Quality of product, customer service and backup.

SolarWide provided an informative evaluation of the previously installed solar panels which were underperforming due to hail damageWith SolarWide assistance the Insurance Company were convinced to replace the systemThe quoting, removal, installation & operation were handled in a professional manner as was the communication with the sales officeHopefully the future performance will match the specifications
Arrived on time for quotes and quoted on what we wanted.Pressue free sales and good follow up

The weather had been wet up to the installation day. We were expecting the installation to be delayed if it rained again. Early morning the rain eased up and the day worked out perfect for roof work: cloudy and cool.The installers were efficient and everything went smoothly even though they were contending with landscapers working around the house at the same time.It was not too long before grid connection was completed and our provider was reporting all the power fed into the grid from the date of installation,

I did loads of research on solar installers and products and after six quotes and four meetings I chose SolarWide due to their knowledgeable consultant, Warwick who graduated from installations and has been with the company for a few years, their platinum rating by solarquotes.com, they only use quality products, their competitive pricing, warranties of 5 years whole system plus 10 years installation workmanship, thorough professionally prepared Agreement with reasonable Terms and Conditions and finally they provided all the product warranty certificates and product information.The whole process was stress free and I found all the staff professional, knowledgeable, helpful and courteous from start to finish.  The friendly installation team turned up on time and although it rained on and off the whole day, they finished well before estimated time and cleaned up at completion.The only issue was with Origin Energy who claimed not receiving the Electrical Work Request from Energex, so Tracey from admin assisted me with that as well.  My 6.6kw system was installed almost three months ago and working brilliantly with high solar production so far.  I am confident the after sales service will be just as seamless so I have no hesitation in highly recommending this company to anyone looking for a competitively priced and reliable high quality system with a stress free installation.

SolarWide was the 4th and final company we sought quotes from based on the reviews SolarQuotes provided. The first 2 companies SolarQuotes connected us with were waaay down on the Gold Coast so only offered generic packages, site unseen. A 3rd company came out on site, had a look around, and we learnt a lot, but while their panels are good quality they were a little underpowered and ultimately could not achieve what we wanted. As we were to learn, string limits (you can only have 13 panels on each string) means you are restricted to an absolute maximum of 39 panels, which doesn't allow for the recommended 33% panel loading when using lower watt panels.The SolarWide chap (Jeb) climbed up on the roof and not only had a look around but took measurements. We were fortunate they didn't rely on satellite imagery to design the panel layout as this would have proven an impossible challenge - we are still an empty block according to the imagery all the companies seem to access, indeed the panel layout we were sent shows it on lawn! :-DWe started our journey thinking in terms of a 10kW panel\inverter option - we have triple phase power but it still depends on your retailer as to what is permitted. Towards the end of it we were leaning towards a 13.3kW panel (33% loading)\10kW inverter system and a different retailer. (Some only care about inverter size\limits, others care about your panel sizes too). Ultimately because of roofing angles and aesthetics - yes that factored in too, we ended up with 36x LG NeON2 350w panels (12.6kW) split into a 5x2 panel north facing string on a single MPPT, and the second MPPT with the dual string equally split between east and west.After many many delays due to the building completion date blowing waaay out, the installation process finally proceeded and all in all was smooth and painless. While it was late in the afternoon when they finished,it was a joy to be able to login to the inverter and see the data.While the inverter data is amazing, and in real time, I had a slight issue logging in to Sunny Portal. SolarWide were happy to help and after a little effort discovered the problem - when SMA say you must include one or more special characters in your password they mean only approved special characters. Turns out some special characters are acceptable in your password but prevent you from actually logging in. Who knew? Thank you SolarWide!!!For our first month our yield figures were 27% above May's estimated average, while today's yield is more than a third above June's average. Obviously cloudier or rainy days will drop the average, and perhaps the difference in summer won't be so great, but for now I'm very happy!Thus I'm more than happy to recommend SolarWide to those looking for solar options.

The whole experience from Solarwide has been honest, fluid and friendly. We’re thrilled with our system. I can’t recommend them enough from Warwick in sales, Ryan and James our installers plus Andy, Cas abs the other guys who helped out.

The team were great to deal with, I needed to change my install day at the last minute and they made it happen! The installers were honest and helpful about what was needed for the job and the benefits of the system being installed, some parts originally quoted were not used in my install and these were then removed from my final invoice. I am yet to have my system connected to the grid, but my power company has been in contact, so to me that means all necessary paperwork has bee filed by the team at SolarWide.
The entire process was fantastic. All our questions were answered with real experience and knowledge. The installers were very professional and the follow up post-installation was great.

The installers were neat and installed the panels and inverters according to plan. They completed their job in a timely matter, and the supervisor on the job ( an electrician) took time to explain to us what to expect from the system. Overall we are pleased with the installation and look forward to the panels being inspected by Energex as soon as possible so that they can function.

Detailed on-site discussion to arrive at the best system for my specific needs. Installation was seamless and all communication prior and post installation timely and helpful. Speedy change of meter arranged. Extremely satisfied with my purchase!

I went with Solar Wide because their sales person came to site, inspected my roof by climbing on it and looked at my power box, before talking me through the options and listened to my questions, before answering. I received prompt responses to my follow-up questions.While I actually had a cheaper price from a competitor, I went with Solar Wide solely because their salesperson came to site (like I asked for) and listened. This experience gave my good confidence there wouldn't be any surprises on the day. Compared to the 'cheaper' quote which had 'and any extras on the day will charged to the customers cost'.The installation on the day was going great until the final setup of the smart meter.
